name: Acquia Connector
description: Allows Drupal to securely communicate with Acquia.
project_description:
Connect your Drupal website to the Acquia Cloud to take advantage of features like Acquia Search and Acquia Personalization.

 Back to top 

 Support guidelines 
 Thank you everyone for your help and feedback with the Acquia Connector module!

If you'd like to report a bug, please create a Drupal.org issue for this module. If you'd like assistance from Acquia Support, please submit a support request via the Acquia Help Center. For more information on how to submit an Acquia Support ticket, please see https://docs.acquia.com/support/tickets/ .

 Back to top 

 Supported versions 
 Acquia Connector 4.x for Drupal 8.9+ 
 Enables secure communication between your Drupal sites and Acquia to monitor uptime, check for updates, and collect site information. Automates the collection of site information - operating system, database, webserver, and PHP versions, installed modules, and site modifications - to speed support communication and issue resolution.

 Back to top 

 Acquia Search is no longer in Connector for Drupal 8+ 
 Starting with Acquia Connector 3.x, Acquia Search has moved to its own module under the same name. Connector 4.x is required for Acquia Search and Perz.

 For customers who use Solr 7, use Acquia Search 3.1.x 

 Run composer require drupal/acquia_search to ensure that you get the correct dependencies. Visit Acquia Search documentation for more information.

 Acquia Connector 7.x-4.x 
 Functionality is split between the following three included modules:

 
 Acquia Agent : Enables secure communication between your Drupal sites and Acquia to monitor uptime, check for updates, and collect site information. 
 Acquia SPI : Insight has been retired , you may safely disable/uninstall this sub-module. 
 Acquia Search : Provides authentication service to the Apache Solr Search Integration module to enable use of Acquia's hosted Solr search indexes. Requires specific versions of the Search modules. Visit Acquia Search documentation for more information.
